source_description_html:
The Rukka Start-R motorcycle Pants are constructed with a 100% breathable, windproof and waterproof Gore-Tex® Z-Liner membrane. The outer fabric is made of abrasion-resistant Cordura® 500D material. The ventilation openings on both sides ensure optimum ventilation and a pleasant draught. For an optimal fit, the Rukka® START-R trousers have a width adjustment on both sides of the waistband; belt loops and an elasticated waistband at the leg end. The width adjustment on the upper arms, waistband and sleeve cuffs offers a perfect fit due to the flexibility. Safety is ensured by Rukka D3O® XTR protectors on the knees, shins and hips. Protector pockets are available for retrofitting with RUKKA® RUKKA® D3O® XTR joint protectors on hips, shins and knees. Furthermore, the trousers have a 360° zipper and can be connected to any Rukka jacket.

source_description_html:
M-CLIMA® is an electro-thermal technology capable of regulating the temperature and humidity of the wearer to mainatain a stable and balanced micro-climate in extreme weather conditions, whether hot or cold. The balanced comfort state eliminates distractions and thus, improves the wearer’s concentration, effectiveness and comfort.

Rukka uses this innovative technology in the Rukka Airconditioned vest powered by M-CLIMA®. Besides the cooling and heating functions, it scores with minimal weight, high breathability, an ergonomic fit and outstanding wearing comfort. The climate management system draws power from the motorbike’s charging system via the fan unit. A simple push of a button on the remote will activate it. The fan then circulates fresh air from outside throughout the whole vest and over the rider’s skin, for an immediate and appreciable cooling effect. Additionally, for the cooling function, the vest comes with a small, handy battery carried in a matching pocket on its back. The battery is good for up to two hours of constant cooling, and can be recharged during any longer breaks. The warming effect can also be activated at the push of a button. The inside of the vest is completely lined with small, semi-conducting silicon panels. Those heating elements’ temperature may reach up to 46 degrees centigrade, a cosy ten degrees above core body temperature.

Features:
  • System Safety: M-CLIMA® is a safe technology due to two independent methods for heating and cooling which prevent the system from overheating or overcooling.
  • Rider Safety: M-CLIMA® keeps the rider in a balanced comfortable state free from distractions even in extreme climate conditions.
  • Interventional Comfort: M-CLIMA® provides comfort in climatic conditions where passive ventilation and standard thermal insulation are not enough.
  • Lightweight and Unobtrusive: M-CLIMA® is designed to minimize weight and optimize ergonomic and sensorial comfort with high level of breathability.
  • Autonomy: M-CLIMA® delivers 2 hours off-bike cooling via Li-ion battery.
  • Mid-Layer: M-CLIMA®´s minimalistic design makes it perfect as a mid-layer under standard motorcycle outer garments.
  • Easy Care: M-CLIMA® vests can be washed without affecting system performance.

    • Specifications:
    Patented Technology:
  • M-CLIMA® Climate Management System is the only flexible fast response personal climate comfort management system for motorcycling.
  • Usable off bike for up to 2 hours; can be worn with protective outer shell garment.
  • <1 min thermal hysteresis on switch on, >3 mins on switch off.
  • Skin temperature reduction/increase of > 3° C (within 31 – 33° C), RH reduction of >25 %, heart rate reduction of >10 bpm.
  • Global Touring, Enduro, Adventure Rider.

    • Heating Mode:
  • Once the M-CLIMA® flexible heating elements are activated, the heating elements reach a
  • self-regulated constant temperature of around 45° C.

    • Cooling Mode:
  • The M-CLIMA® blower unit pushes air inside the system. The air becomes a turbulent flow next to the skin, accelerating the evaporative cooling effect.
